title: What I have built and tested.
dim: Hands-on work behind the research, with evidence for each skill.
lede: My PhD is experimental. Most of it is building systems, running them under controlled attack scenarios and checking the results, not writing alone.

items.what: The Python implementation of my encrypted smart-home experiments, plus scripts that correlate packet captures with broker and application logs and check every decrypted result against a plaintext reference.
Paillier partial homomorphic encryption implemented end to end with 2048-bit and 3072-bit keys, including encrypted aggregation and authorised decryption.
Mosquitto brokers configured with credentials and topic access control lists, relaying 15 simulated sensor streams between virtual machines, with Home Assistant automation downstream.
Controlled replay, spoofing, flooding and message-modification experiments from an isolated attacker machine, then message-age, duplicate and malformed-message checks tested against them.
Wireshark and tcpdump captures correlated with broker and application logs, with SHA-256 integrity hashes on archived evidence.
Phishing URL detection comparing eight classifiers on a 70/30 split, evaluated with confusion matrices and ROC curves, then built into a web prototype for SMEs.
Disk image acquisition and examination in academic forensic exercises, with findings written up as reports.
Hands-on Microsoft Azure exercises in networking, identity and storage, being written up as documented labs. Not yet certified.
ZeroSeal, Citizen and Omela built and deployed alongside my PhD.
